lines.t: I behold your hands, I see your feet
And I'm undone by the love you poured on me
Every scar of passion softly calls my name
A holy covenant that forever stays the same
Every mark of mercy, every trace of pain
Is like a quiet fire running through my veins
I can feel the promise written deep and true
Etched in living blood that was shed for me, not you
In the silence, in the stillness, I can feel it rise
Love like distant thunder rolling through my life
Your love was written in every stripe you bore for me
Poured out in every drop of blood you chose to bleed
Revealed when they pierced your wounded hands and feet
Now my heart is opening, falling at your feet
In this quiet, I remember what you've done for me
In this stillness, I surrender to this mystery
You invite my soul, you say come taste and drink
And my empty heart is filled more than I can think
What was veiled before is breaking into light
And the void inside is fading in your quiet mind
All my restless questions soften in your gaze
As the weight of glory settles in this place
I can feel the nearness closer than my breath
Love so overwhelming, stronger than my fear of death
In the whispers of your mercy, I can hear it clear
A gentle invitation drawing me near
Your love was written in every strife you bore for me
Poured out in every drop of blood you chose to bleed
Revealed when they pierced your wounded hands and feet
Now my heart is opening, falling at your feet
In this quiet, I remember what You've done for me
In this stillness, I surrender to this mystery
You endured the sorrow, took the burning shame
And somehow in that anguish, You were calling out my name
Every wound you carry holds a vow to stay
An everlasting promise that will never fade away
You have bound my life with yours in crimson grace
A union sealed forever, no one can erase
In the hush of worship, I can feel it true
I am not my own, now I belong to you
Love was written line by line upon your skin
Every hidden fracture drawing my heart in
Here beneath the weight of all you chose to bear
I can feel the covenant hanging in the air
I behold your hands, I see your feet
And in this holy silence
Your love completes me
you
